generator.program.note: The lineage's own program (growth plan G2.3a), on the herb base: it gives the values its species leave unset, which the herb program gave as defaults until then.

traits.note: Jepson's Manual of the Flowering Plants of California (1925), read in full: flowers perfect, perigynous; calyx 5-lobed; petals commonly 5; ovary partly or wholly inferior, or superior, so its position is each genus's. Family summaries (as quoted in search results; the pages themselves were not read): carpels usually 2, joined below; Tolmiea is bilaterally symmetric.

traits.woodiness.note: Hutchinson (vol. 1, 2nd ed., 1959), family 300 Saxifragaceae (in the narrow sense APG also takes): herbs, little or not at all succulent; leaves alternate, without stipules; fruit a capsule with many small seeds.
